demo.title: basket-agent.sh
demo.code:
# Read a basket: NAV, holdings, weights, with provenance
"What's in the AIBASKET basket on Base?"
# ✓ AI Tokens Basket ($AIBASKET) · AUM $... · NAV $... (onchain)
# ✓ legs: VVV 40% · A0T 35% · BNKR 25%

# Build a new basket from a thesis
"Create a 60/40 basket of AAVE and UNI called MyThesis on Base"
# ✓ legs resolved + routed · CREATE2 address mined
# → deploy calls returned for your wallet to sign

# Buy: the floor comes from a LIVE simulation, never guessed
"Buy $250 of AIBASKET"
# ✓ simulated fill - slippage = the signed floor
# → { approval, swap } for your wallet · signing stays in your wallet

# Get out: the unconditional exit that always works
"Redeem my AIBASKET in kind"
# → redeemInKind calldata · touches no pool, needs no floor

setup: Clone the open-source kit: `git clone https://github.com/Irora-dev/Spectrum`
Build the server: `cd Spectrum/app && npm install && npm run mcp:build`
Verify the install: `bash Spectrum/mcp/run.sh --check` (node version, build, live handshake + health, PASS/FAIL lines)
Register the MCP server: point your agent at `Spectrum/mcp/run.sh`
For live buy/sell quotes, set a provider RPC (e.g. VITE_ALCHEMY_API_KEY); the trade simulation needs eth_simulateV1 or eth_call state overrides. Reads, create, and the exit work on any RPC
Compose-only by default: the skill returns transactions for YOUR wallet to sign; it never holds keys or sends unless you set MCP_OPERATOR_KEY
Security disclosures go through the public repo's issue tracker: https://github.com/Irora-dev/Spectrum/issues

install.command: git clone https://github.com/Irora-dev/Spectrum && cd Spectrum/app && npm install && npm run mcp:build
